title: healthiar: Quantifying and Monetizing Health Impacts Attributable to Exposure
description: An R package for quantifying and monetizing the burden of disease attributable to environmental exposures (such as air and noise pollution). Developed under the framework of the European Union project BEST-COST. Disclaimer: It is work in progress and the developers are not liable for any calculation errors or inaccuracies resulting from the use of this package.
